decisions.summary: Approved access, protected persistence/offline behavior, lifecycle, duplicates, SupplierItem drafts, independent payee verification, CSV deferral and rollback.
Spain, the United States and Colombia are the initial jurisdictions; exact tax fields remain subject to Finance/Legal validation.
Only owners/admins may verify payment instructions, and the verifier differs from the editor.
SupplierItem may link to canonical Product or variant; unlinked drafts are not purchasable until same-org link and positive conversion.
Finance/Legal must validate exact identifiers, formats and required tax fields before country-specific tax-profile work.
User confirmed ERP > Proveedores, separate from CRM and the Products catalog; route/runtime behavior still requires audit evidence.
User authorized task-scoped execution for tasks not dependent on country-specific tax rules; tax-profile tasks remain blocked pending Finance/Legal evidence.

actions: Recorded the approved defaults, initial jurisdictions, owner/admin maker-checker rule and Product-or-variant SupplierItem link target.
Recorded ERP > Proveedores as the approved navigation location.
Recorded task-scoped approval for tasks not dependent on country tax rules; the first executable batch is mandatory audits plus CSV/P2P boundary audits.
Kept country-specific tax rules and their dependent P2P implementation blocked pending Finance/Legal evidence; no production code has been changed.

validation.result: passed: 9 ledgers checked with scoped task approvals.

requirements.evidence: Scope, route choice and non-tax task scope are approved; route/runtime audit evidence remains to be collected.
The generic P2P contract is approved; country-specific tax profile and dependent domain/renderers remain blocked pending Finance/Legal evidence.
Manual SupplierItem/Product linking tasks are approved; CSV remains explicitly out of scope.

next_handoff: 07-build after explicit plan completion and handoff

prebuild_decisions.domain: Approved: Supplier lifecycle active/on_hold/inactive, no hard delete, existing transaction facts remain unchanged; exact tax-ID duplicates within the organization and jurisdiction block, normalized-name similarity warns; SupplierItem may be an unlinked draft and is purchasable only when linked to the same-organization canonical Product or its variant with positive conversion. Initial jurisdictions are Spain, the United States and Colombia; exact tax-field rules require Finance/Legal validation.
prebuild_decisions.access: Approved: a Supplier-specific read grant maps to the same user population as Products readers, including tax/bank visibility; Supplier management maps to the Products writer population; organization scope is derived server-side. Only owner/admin may verify payee instructions, and the verifier must be a different person from the editor. Mutations require immutable audit evidence.
prebuild_decisions.persistence: Approved: real tax/bank values use protected, server-authoritative persistence; never store them in localStorage or a clear local cache, and do not support offline reads, writes or queued mutations for those values. Local fixtures use synthetic data; offline behavior may cover only non-sensitive data.
prebuild_decisions.platform_reuse: Approved: reuse existing Rivera and LoopDev Platform primitives/contracts; desktop and responsive mobile web only; do not build native apps or duplicate shared controls. Canonical Product creation stays in Products. CSV import is deferred from this slice; downstream PO/receipt/invoice/payment transactions stay in their owning modules.
prebuild_decisions.rollback: Approved: organization-scoped feature flag, forward migration with dry-run, stop writes/retries when disabled, return to a safe read-only mode, preserve audit and downstream transaction history, and never use hard-delete cascades.
